newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stock exchange suspends Pikko.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stock exchange suspends Pikko.

text.p: The Jakarta stock exchange suspended trading of minor-sized Bank Pikko following a 207.69 percent rise in the stock, an exchange official said.
"We have suspended the trading of Bank Pikko as the rise was just too high," the exchange's head of the monitoring division, Hamud Balfast, told Reuters.

"The bank told us on Monday that the firm had no new corporate actions that had not been published, but then this morning we read a story in the Neraca daily that an investor wanted to buy a large stake in the bank," Balfast said.
Bank Pikko rose 2,700 rupiah to 4,000 rupiah with 21.7 million shares traded on the take-over rumours before it was suspended, brokers said.
